card: Deduplicates the block validation state catcher into a shared `node/block_validation_state_catcher.h` header, unifying identical `CValidationInterface` listener implementations across `submitblock`, `BlockTemplateManager`, and mining test helpers. Reviewers on PR #34644 and PR #35675 noted the duplication when adding block submission and mining features. No behavior change is intended.
changed_since_previous: Now includes the complete patch; implementation details confirm replacing the separate `found` boolean flags with `std::optional<BlockValidationState>` across all three call sites.
evidence: PR description cites review feedback requesting deduplication: https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34644#discussion_r2889315162 and https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35675#discussion_r360301816
problem: Three separate call sites (`submitblock` RPC, `BlockTemplateManager::SubmitBlock`, and the test mining helper `ProcessBlock`) independently define identical `CValidationInterface` classes to capture synchronous `BlockChecked` validation results for a block hash, duplicating code and using slightly different state-tracking conventions.

risk.why: A bug in validation state recording could result in incorrect error reporting or inconclusive error strings when submitting blocks via RPC or IPC.

scope_notes: Small mechanical cleanup moving three local validation interface listener implementations into a single header `node/block_validation_state_catcher.h`.
summary: Extracts the block validation state listener helper into `node/block_validation_state_catcher.h` and reuses it across the block template manager, the `submitblock` RPC, and mining test utilities. The unified class replaces duplicate `CValidationInterface` implementations and standardizes state capture tracking using `std::optional<BlockValidationState>` instead of separate boolean flags.
